tutorial_freq_sub_bass_desc: The Rumble, usually out of human's hearing range and tend to be felt more than heard, providing a sense of power.
tutorial_freq_bass_desc: Determines how 'fat' or 'thin' the sound is. Boosting around 250 Hz tends to add warmth. If you're a bass head you most likely like this range.
tutorial_freq_lower_mids_desc: Low order harmonics of most instruments, generally viewed as the bass presence range. Boosting around 300 Hz adds clarity to the bass. Too much around 500 Hz can make higher-frequency instruments sound muffled.
tutorial_freq_upper_mids_desc: The high midrange is responsible for the attack on percussive and rhythm instruments. Boosting this range can add presence. However, too much around 3 kHz can cause listening fatigue.
tutorial_freq_presence_desc: The presence range is responsible for the clarity and definition of a sound. Over-boosting can cause an irritating, harsh sound. Cutting here makes the sound more distant and transparent.
tutorial_freq_brilliance_desc: The brilliance range is composed entirely of harmonics and is responsible for sparkle and air of a sound. Over-boosting can accentuate hiss and cause ear fatigue.

link_start_hint: You can also edit this EQ together with uniPEQ, which writes it to the device connected there.
link_help_what: uniPEQ is a free app for Android and web browsers. It reads and writes the EQ built into many USB DACs, dongles, headphones and IEMs.
link_help_why: Linked, the EQ you build here against a measurement, by hand or with AutoEQ, is sent to the device connected with uniPEQ.
link_help_phone: It works on a Android phone alone: a phone's browser can't reach USB devices, but uniPEQ can.
link_waiting: Open uniPEQ and enter this code, or scan the QR code with the phone that has uniPEQ.
link_qr_label: QR code that opens uniPEQ and links it with this page
link_other_server: This site uses its own link server, so a code typed in uniPEQ won't find it. Scan the QR code, or use Open uniPEQ.
link_stalled: uniPEQ isn't answering. Open it on your phone.
link_read_only: uniPEQ takes no edits while its device reconnects.
link_read_only_no_device: Connect a device in uniPEQ to edit this EQ.
link_device_rejected: uniPEQ's device came with limits this page can't read, so Hardware EQ doesn't show it.
link_paused: uniPEQ was paused for {seconds} s by Android

link_ended_version_site: This site's link is older than uniPEQ's. The site needs a newer modernGraphTool.
link_ended_timeout: The link ended: uniPEQ stopped answering.
link_ended_replaced: uniPEQ linked with another page instead.
link_ended_room_full: Another app joined this code first.
